name: dots-brain
description: Install and operate a personal, source-aware memory service on your own host.

interface.shortDescription: One memory for your AI tools
interface.longDescription: Start shared memory on your host, configure supported local clients, and authorize OAuth clients without printing tokens. Public ingress, web-account setup, conversation capture, native views, and MCP Events are not automated.
interface.defaultPrompt: Set up Dots Brain on my memory host and verify the available capabilities.
